customTask.title: Add Custom Task
customTask.hint: Saved tasks will be included in random dispatch
customTask.placeholder: Write the first thing you need to do...

task.open_first_desktop_file: Open the first file on your desktop from the left
task.type_period_in_new_doc: Create a blank document and type a single period
task.close_all_notifications: Close all notification pop-ups on your computer
task.write_todays_date: Write today's date on a piece of paper
task.mark_first_email_read: Open your email and mark the first inbox email as read
task.move_three_files_to_folder: Select three files on your desktop and drag them into a new folder
task.adjust_screen_brightness: Increase or decrease your screen brightness by one level
task.close_first_browser_tab: Close the first open tab in your browser
task.put_nearest_clothes_in_washer: Put the piece of dirty clothing nearest to you into the washer
task.take_kitchen_trash_out: Take the kitchen trash bag to the door
task.smooth_blanket_and_pillow: Smooth out your blanket and arrange your pillow
task.pick_up_socks_to_basket: Pick up the socks by your feet and put them in the laundry basket
task.lay_out_tomorrows_clothes: Lay out one set of clothes for tomorrow on your bed
task.move_nearest_bowl_to_sink: Take the bowl closest to your hand on the table to the sink
task.fold_snack_bag_into_drawer: Fold the snack bag on the coffee table and put it in a drawer
task.pick_up_three_things_from_floor: Pick up the three things nearest to you on the floor and put them away
task.send_period_to_first_contact: Send a single period to the first contact in your address book
task.send_emoji_to_top_chat: Open your chat app and send an emoji to the top pinned contact
task.find_first_A_contact: Open your contacts and find the first person whose name starts with A
task.clear_all_red_badges: Clear all red badge notifications on your phone
task.put_on_nearest_shoes_and_tiptoe: Put on the pair of shoes nearest to you and stand on your tiptoes three times
task.stretch_arms_overhead_five_times: Stand up and stretch your arms overhead five times
task.walk_to_nearest_window_look_out: Walk to the nearest window and look outside for ten seconds
task.pour_water_and_drink_three_sips: Pour a glass of water and take three sips
task.flip_phone_screen_down: Flip your phone screen-down onto the table
task.close_eyes_count_breaths_to_five: Close your eyes and count your breaths up to five
task.write_start_on_paper: Write the word "Start" on a piece of paper
task.stack_top_three_papers: Stack the top three pieces of paper on your desk neatly
task.take_out_and_put_back_cards: Take all cards out of your wallet and put them back in
task.empty_bag_and_put_back: Empty everything out of your bag and put it back in
